newsitem.title: UK: Emirates increases flights to Nairobi and Jakarta.
newsitem.headline: Emirates increases flights to Nairobi and Jakarta.

text.p: Dubai government-owned Emirates airline said it will increase weekly flights to Nairobi and Jakarta from October 27, when the airline commences its winter schedule.
In a statement issued here, Emirates said the Kenyan government has approved the launch a third weekly flight between Dubai and Nairobi.
Flights to Jakarta are to increase to four a weekv via Singapore.

Ghaith Al Ghaith, Emirates' commercial director said: "The flights between Dubai and Nairobi are among Emirates' most successful, with demand for seats on the sector continuing to grow." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
